compiler_finding.source_requested: Preservation and RTE at multiple widths; glslc retains only the last width per repeated mode.

radeon_failure.meaning: RNE tie must round to the even upper half value. The shader omitted RTE16; observed result is consistent with truncation.

compiler_finding.fix: Only NVFP4 F16 module creation expands/deduplicates each of the three control modes to16/32/64 and refuses missing modes. Device capability checks cover all requested modes. No double arithmetic added, and no other module rewritten.
compiler_finding.verification: Unchanged shader bytes fail before and pass after the module-creation repair on Radeon. Independently reconstructed repaired SPIR-V passes spirv-val --target-env vulkan1.2 with all nine modes present.
compiler_finding.separate_existing_finding: The older MXFP4 module also loses source-declared SignedZeroInfNanPreserve64. Reported to F2DEV, unchanged here. Missing metadata alone does not demonstrate a numerical failure.

docs_review: Prior full tracked Markdown review carried forward for unchanged behavior. New review covered every affected NVFP4/F16/capability/witness claim and updated STATUS, PRECISION, USAGE and both Vulkan/NVFP4 source-owner pages. No CLI flag or tolerance changed.
